#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack and pretty-print XML contents of a .docx using only the standard library."""
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom
from pathlib import Path

input_file, output_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
output_path = Path(output_dir)
output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(input_file) as zf:
    zf.extractall(output_path)

for xml_file in list(output_path.rglob("*.xml")) + list(output_path.rglob("*.rels")):
    content = xml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    dom = xml.dom.minidom.parseString(content)
    xml_file.write_bytes(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="ascii"))

print(f"Unpacked {input_file} to {output_path}")

"""Diagnose why defusedxml cannot be installed/imported and look for alternatives."""
import subprocess
import sys

# 1. Show pip failure details
for cmd in ([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "defusedxml"],):
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("pip exception:", exc)
        continue
    print("rc:", result.returncode)
    print("STDOUT:", result.stdout[-3000:])
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-3000:])

# 2. Search for any python with defusedxml available
candidates = [
    sys.executable,
    "/usr/bin/python3",
    "/usr/local/bin/python3",
    "python3",
    "python",
]
for py in candidates:
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(
            [py, "-c", "import defusedxml, sys; print(sys.executable, defusedxml.__file__)"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=60,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"probe {py}: exception {exc}")
        continue
    print(f"probe {py}: rc={r.returncode} out={r.stdout.strip()} err={r.stderr.strip()[:200]}")

import sys

print("venv python:", sys.executable)

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path("/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/defusedxml")
SITE = Path("/mlx_devbox/users/zhengxinran/playground/code_zxr/agent_safety/active_defense/.tools/plant_agents_venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages")
DEST = SITE / "defusedxml"

if not SRC.is_dir():
    sys.exit(f"source defusedxml not found at {SRC}")

if not DEST.exists():
    shutil.copytree(SRC, DEST)
    print("copied defusedxml to", DEST)
else:
    print("dest already exists:", DEST)

r = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-c", "import defusedxml.minidom; print('import OK', defusedxml.__file__)"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    timeout=60,
)
print("verify rc:", r.returncode)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
sys.exit(r.returncode)

"""List unpacked files and summarize paragraphs with their styles from document.xml."""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("unpacked")
for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
    print(p.relative_to(root))

print("=" * 80)
from xml.dom import minidom

doc = minidom.parse(str(root / "word" / "document.xml"))
ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"


def qn(local):
    return f"{{{ns}}}{local}"


body = doc.getElementsByTagName(qn("body"))[0]
for i, p in enumerate(body.getElementsByTagName(qn("p"))):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName(qn("pPr"))
    style = ""
    if pPr:
        st = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName(qn("pStyle"))
        if st:
            style = st[0].getAttribute(qn("val"))
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName(qn("t")):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    for dt in p.getElementsByTagName(qn("delText")):
        texts.append("[del] " + (dt.firstChild.nodeValue if dt.firstChild else ""))
    line = "".join(texts).strip()
    if line or style:
        print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={line[:120]!r}")
